import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        ArrayList<Long>[] buckets = new ArrayList[11];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
            buckets[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        long[] sum_buckets = new long[11];
        final long MOD_A = 998244353;
        final long MOD_B = 1000000007;
        long counter = 0;
        long temp_counter = 0;
        long answer = 0;

        // Helper function for modular arithmetic
        long modA(long x) {
            return ((x % MOD_A) + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
        }

        // fill1 function
        class Fill1 {
            void recurse(int level, long val) {
                if (val > n) return;
                if (level > 6) return;
                counter++;
                long v = modA(counter - val);
                buckets[level].add(v);
                sum_buckets[level] += v;
                for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
                    recurse(level + 1, val * 10 + digit);
                }
            }
        }

        // fill2 function
        class Fill2 {
            void recurse(int level, long val) {
                if (val > n) return;
                if (level >= 1) {
                    if (val * 10 * n > n && val * n + n - 1 <= n) {
                        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                            long v = modA(counter - val);
                            List<Long> vec = buckets[i];
                            int pos = lowerBound(vec, MOD_A - v);
                            long size = vec.size();
                            long sum = sum_buckets[i];
                            answer = (answer + v * size + sum - MOD_A * (size - pos)) % MOD_B;
                        }
                        counter += temp_counter;
                        return;
                    }
                    counter++;
                    long v = modA(counter - val);
                    answer = (answer + v) % MOD_B;
                }
                for (int digit = (level == 0 ? 1 : 0); digit <= 9; digit++) {
                    recurse(level + 1, val * 10 + digit);
                }
            }
        }

        // Run fill1
        new Fill1().recurse(0, 0);
        temp_counter = counter;
        counter = 0;

        // Sort buckets
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(buckets[i]);
        }

        // Run fill2
        new Fill2().recurse(0, 0);

        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    // Helper method for lower_bound
    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
